title: Light and dark
examples: What makes it bright when the sun comes up?
How do our eyes see things that are dark?
Can you name something that makes its own light?

explain.say: Say light comes from something called a light source.

draw.text: Light Sources: Things that make light

explain.say: Say the sun is a very big natural light source.
Say we also see light from things like flashlights.
Say we need light to help our eyes see things clearly.
Say at night, the sky is dark because the sun is gone.
Say when it is dark, we use small light sources to help us.

faq.q: Why is the sun the biggest light source?
faq.a: The sun is a star, and stars are huge balls of hot gas that make their own light. It is the most powerful natural light source we see.
asks: Where does the sun get its light?
Is the sun a light bulb?

faq.q: Can we see in the dark without any lights?
faq.a: No, our eyes need some light to send pictures to our brain. If it is completely dark, we cannot see things.
asks: Do we need light to see?
How do we see when it is pitch black?

faq.q: What are some things that make light?
faq.a: Things that make their own light are called light sources. Examples include fire, light bulbs, and the sun.

faq.q: Why is it dark at night?
faq.a: It is dark at night because the Earth turns around, and the side facing away from the sun is in shadow. The sun is shining on the other side.
asks: Why does the sky change color?

faq.a: No, some light sources are natural, like the sun. Others are made by people, like electric lights.
asks: What is the difference between natural and man-made light?

facts: Light travels very fast, faster than anything else.
The sun is a natural light source because it is a star.
We need light to help our eyes send pictures to our brain.
At night, the sky is dark because the sun is on the other side of Earth.

quiz.say: Which of these things is a light source?
quiz.why: A light bulb is made by people and it makes its own light.

wrong.1: The moon only reflects light from the sun; it does not make its own light.
wrong.2: A book only has pictures and words; it does not produce any light.
wrong.3: Trees are plants and they do not generate light for us to see.

quiz.say: If it is completely dark, what happens to our vision?

options.show: We can see with our noses.
options.say: We can see with our noses.

options.show: We can see with our ears.
options.say: We can see with our ears.

quiz.why: Our eyes need light to capture images that our brain can understand.

wrong.0: Our eyes do not get stronger just because it is dark; they just can't take in enough light.
wrong.1: Smell helps us know things are near, but it does not help our eyes see objects.
wrong.3: Hearing helps us know things are there, but it does not replace the need for light to see.

quiz.say: Which word describes the time when the sun is not visible?
quiz.why: Night is the time when the Earth has turned so the sun is on the other side.

wrong.0: Evening is when the sun is going down, but it is not the whole time of darkness.
wrong.2: Day is when the sun is shining brightly on our side of the Earth.
wrong.3: Morning is just a part of the day when the sun is rising.
